refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback identifies high-priority gaps in CQ coverage and quality. The following issues are prioritized: (1) Add additional data properties for Organization (legal name, contact info) and Item (description, product code) for full CQ5/CQ8 coverage; (2) Introduce SHACL shapes or OWL cardinality restrictions to enforce mandatory fields for CQ13; (3) Add OWL restrictions (someValuesFrom/allValuesFrom) for properties like hasItem and hasOrganizationRole for better structure; (4) Define equivalence axioms for key classes (e.g., InvoiceMessage as Message with specific segments) for richer reasoning; (5) Optionally, expand Address with structured properties (street, city, postal code, country). No constraint violations found, but quality can be improved with OWL restrictions and equivalence axioms. Plan: (a) Add missing Organization and Item data properties; (b) Add OWL restrictions and at least one equivalence axiom; (c) Add cardinality/mandatory property restrictions for required fields; (d) Optionally enrich Address; (e) Preserve existing correct elements.
